get_test_filename: create a temporary test file with a random name and specified extension in the system temp directory
async_test: decorate an async test function to run it in an asyncio event loop
local_test: decorate a test function to skip it when running in the Sandcastle environment
get_free_port: get an available free TCP port number by binding a socket to port zero
get_event_loop: get the current asyncio event loop or create a new one if the existing loop is closed
